name: const unsafe fn as_uninit_slice < 'a > (self) -> & 'a [MaybeUninit < T >]
rule: Even if the result is unused, self must point to self.len() consecutive properly initialized values of MaybeUninit<T>; the underlying values of type T need not be initialized.
